data.name: Cloverly
data.description: Cloverly is an Atlanta-based carbon credit marketplace and software platform founded in 2019. It connects buyers with curated carbon removal and reduction credits via API and a marketplace, and offers Catalyst, a commercial software for project developers to manage inventory, distribution, and sales across channels including the Salesforce Net Zero marketplace.
